laoCai.title: Adjustment of the Lào Cai city master plan
laoCai.imageAlt: Master plan for the city of Lào Cai
laoCai.body: The planning area covers 28,162.64 ha, with completion targeted for 2045. It is a long-term strategy for restructuring urban space so land can be used flexibly, sustainably and in ways that adapt to climate change. The plan balances housing, commercial and industrial land with public space and green areas, and expands transport, water, energy and digital infrastructure. It also sets a clear path for population growth and new residential districts, strengthening Lào Cai as a regional economic and transport hub.

hopThanh.title: Detailed construction plan for Hợp Thành commune, scale 1/500
hopThanh.location: Hợp Thành commune, Lào Cai City
hopThanh.imageAlt: Detailed plan for Hợp Thành commune, Lào Cai
hopThanh.body: This 2,693.3 ha 1/500 detailed construction plan translates the city-wide master plan into clear functional zones, a street network and technical and social infrastructure. It is intended as a foundation for sustainable urbanisation: a modern, coordinated and environmentally responsive district that can adapt to future economic and social demand, while upgrading existing infrastructure to serve residents and attract investment through 2025.

subdivision6b.title: Subdivision plan 6B (Nguyễn Ái Quốc Ward)
subdivision6b.imageAlt: Subdivision plan 6B, Nguyễn Ái Quốc Ward
subdivision6b.body: Subdivision 6B is a strategic step in restructuring Hải Dương, covering more than 1,100 ha in Nguyễn Ái Quốc Ward. The plan coordinates technical infrastructure, expands the city’s ecological urban space and establishes modern functional districts, shaping the city’s form after 2025.

cocSan.title: Cốc San construction subdivision plan
cocSan.body: The Cốc San subdivision is a key part of Lào Cai’s urban expansion. It combines advanced technical infrastructure with the existing landscape to form a balanced ecological district, and prepares the ground for high-quality housing, commercial services and public facilities tied into the regional transport corridor.

dongYen.title: Đông Yên urban master plan, Bắc Quang District
dongYen.location: Đồng Yên commune, Hà Giang City
dongYen.body: Đông Yên is an ambitious master plan of nearly 4,500 ha with a horizon to 2050. It sets out a smart satellite town that brings living, working and leisure together, and is intended as an investment destination and a model for sustainable modern urbanism in the northern uplands.

naChi.title: Nà Chì urban master plan, Xín Mần District
naChi.location: Nà Chì commune, Xín Mần, Hà Giang
naChi.body: Nà Chì is one of the largest plans in Vietnam’s northern mountains. Covering more than 8,000 ha, it is meant to lift infrastructure, services and investment in Xín Mần while keeping highland identity and introducing smarter infrastructure models — an opening for Hà Giang.

tanBac.title: Tân Bắc urban master plan, Quang Bình District
tanBac.location: Tân Bắc commune, Quang Bình, Hà Giang
tanBac.body: Tân Bắc is emerging as a new centre for Quang Bình District. This plan of more than 6,000 ha focuses on contemporary living space, a green-technology ecosystem and coordinated public amenities. The 2050 horizon aims to make Tân Bắc a highland planning model that keeps local character while keeping pace with national urbanisation.

namDong.title: Subdivision plan 5A (Nam Đồng Ward), Hải Dương City
namDong.location: Hải Dương City, Hải Dương Province
namDong.body: Subdivision 5A is a core piece of Hải Dương’s sustainable-growth strategy. On just over 330 ha it concentrates on a modern urban layout, stronger connections and a more flexible urban ecosystem, raising living quality and the appeal of the Nam Đồng area in the next development phase.

xuanAn.title: Detailed plan for Park City Xuân An eco-urban area
xuanAn.location: Xuân An town, Nghi Xuân District, Hà Tĩnh Province
xuanAn.imageAlt: Park City Xuân An eco-urban area
xuanAn.body: Park City Xuân An is a compact, carefully designed eco-urban district of nearly 28 ha. Guided by “live green, live well”, it combines generous green space with modern commercial amenities and coordinated infrastructure — a new high-quality, sustainable urban offer for Hà Tĩnh and central Vietnam.

slides: The Institute for Construction, Urban and Economic Research (hereafter, the Institute) was established under Decision No. 29/QĐ/THXDVN of 16 April 2013 by the Presidium of the Vietnam Federation of Civil Engineering Associations

More than 10 years of experience, over 20 outstanding young staff and specialists alongside many leading experts in planning, urban development and urban economics — we have designed cities that are smart, green and environmentally friendly, balanced between function, resilience and the needs of the community
Scientific research, applied research and technology development in construction, consultancy, urban development planning, urban economics, construction economics and environmental protection.

Transfer of scientific technology and green transition. Delivering information services and organising conferences and workshops at home and internationally. Partnership and collaboration with domestic and international organisations across planning, urban development and environmental protection effectively , and connectivity — building cities ready for the future .
Leading the city-wide planning initiative for Đà Nẵng across class 1 and class 2 cities — a transformative project reflecting our commitment to whole-picture strategy and real-world results.

Research and preparation of schemes and planning projects, urban and rural planning; housing development programmes; urban economics and the urban environment; construction investment; real-estate market information; procurement and tendering…
